vibe: Cinematic, moody, expensive feel with deep shadows and glamorous golden accents.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale p-8, p-12, p-16).
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: The Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) for side-by-side uploads and history gallery.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating elements (backdrop-blur-xl), solid dark backgrounds for data.

buttons.primary: Solid Gold/Amber text on dark background with The Tracing Beam (glow) effect, or glowing border. Hover: scale slightly, increase glow.
buttons.secondary: Glass button, bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-md, 1px white/10 border

inputs.style: Dark background (bg-black/40), white/10 border, ring-amber-500/50 on focus. Soft padding (p-4).

cards.style: Crystal Glass variant: bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10), soft shadow. Rounded-2xl.

micro_animations.hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border color brightens to white/30.
micro_animations.loading: Cinematic pulse / skeleton shimmer using framer-motion. Text: 'Staging the scene...', 'Adjusting lights...'
micro_animations.reveal: Fade-in with slow scale down (1.05 -> 1.0) for the generated image.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA > 60 for text. Use drop-shadows on text over images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout with a fixed or sticky glassmorphism header.
The Hero section should have a title like 'Star In Your Own Scene' using Cormorant Garamond text-5xl.
Implement two upload dropzones using the bento grid strategy (one for user, one for celebrity).
Use framer-motion for the Generate button and image reveal animations.
Ensure the history gallery uses a masonry or bento layout (not boring square grids).
DO NOT use generic UI layouts; ensure asymmetrical spacing where appropriate.
Apply background texture (cinematic_background) with low opacity behind the UI or as a full screen fixed background.
Use data-testid attributes extensively as per guidelines.
Combine the photos based on user's text prompt securely.
Avoid generic 'SaaS Blue' or purple/violet on white colors.
